thread:
sara: heads-up — upstream FlashAttention r3 merged into main and our canary shows a regression for paged-attn on A100 (long sequences). p95 is ~1.4x higher.
max: can you share the raw numbers?
sara: profiler snapshot pasted below (canary vs baseline):
```
seq=8192 model=rw-medium
baseline (paged-attn-legacy): p95=118ms p99=255ms tokens/s=445
FA-r3 (upstream):           p95=167ms p99=372ms tokens/s=312
```
kevin: ugh. any clue whether this is kernel compute or memory behavior?
sara: looks like KV-cache churn + allocator pattern change. We see ~18% more cache hash collisions and 30% higher device memcpy time in the sample traces.
olivia: vLLM recently merged a patch that tweaks eviction/kv-compact semantics (PR #457) — might help if we can upstream their fix. xFormers also changed qkv packing in PR #982 which could affect kernel dispatch rules.
anjali: short term: propose we pin kernel selection heuristic in runtime: if seq_len >= 4096 && kv_enabled => force paged-attn-legacy; else allow FA-r3. Add canary fallback policy.
max: agree. Also add a perf regression guard: auto rollback if p95 increases >10% vs pinned baseline for 5m.
sara: created a quick patch to runtime heuristics; config snippet below to flip on the pin for canary: 
```
# runtime config
kernels:
  attention:
    heuristics_version: "2026-09-10-v1"
    long_seq_strategy:
      min_seq: 4096
      kernel: "paged-attn-legacy"
      reason: "workaround upstream FA-r3 regression"
```
kevin: do we need a vendor fallback too? I remember VendorX dropped one vectorized path in their driver update last month. Could combine: kernel selection -> prefer legacy -> fallback to vendor-fallback when driver reports missing symbol.
olivia: I'll open issues against FA and xFormers with our traces (sara, can you attach profiler logs + a minimal repro?). Also cc vLLM folks about the eviction semantics note.
sara: attaching repro gist: https://gist.github.com/rw/repro-paged-attn-canary (small script to run seq=8192 on A100, uses our model). CI logs attached in thread.
ci-bot: canary deploy started for 5% of traffic in us-west1 on 2026-09-10T20:00Z. Monitoring hooks: perf, error-rate, kv-cache-misses.
max: runbook: 1) start canary 2) monitor p95/p99 and cache-miss rate 3) if p95>baseline*1.10 OR cache-miss delta > +10% -> rollback to kernels heuristics v2026-09-09.
anjali: also add a telemetry tag so we can filter retrospective traces by heuristic_version.
kevin: reminder to coordinate with Dedicated infra — pinned kernel may change resource packing. I'll loop in ekaterina in eng-infra.
olivia: timeline: we'll keep pin for 48h while FA/xFormers respond. If upstream provides a patch within that window we'll test their patch in staging.
sara: Action items: (1) runtime PR to pin heuristics (sara) (2) open upstream issues + upload traces (olivia + sara) (3) canary + rollback guard (max + ci-bot) (4) notify infra about packing impact (kevin).
max: thanks — please post short summary in #incidents if we end up rolling back. :thumbsup:
kevin: adding note — possible follow-up: add microbench harness per kernel so we can run perf diffs automatically on all upstream merges.
sara: good idea, will prototype microbench next sprint.
olivia: one more: if vLLM's eviction change helps we may be able to remove the pin and prefer FA-r3 for short sequences only. We'll validate after their patch lands.
sara: ok closing for now, will keep thread updated with canary metrics. :eyes:
